clues.title: Plate: Cyprus
text: Cyprus uses both standard white European license plates, and UK-style plates that have a yellow rear plate. Most license plates have the EU strip on the left. Rental cars, which have a distinct red plate, are not uncommon either.

clues.title: Language: Greek
text: Cyprus (the Republic of Cyprus) mainly uses the Greek language. Greek has a unique alphabet not used in any other language. It shares similarities with both the Latin and Cyrillic alphabets, however the lower case letters generally have softer shapes than the Cyrillic letters. English is also common to find on the island, due to Cyprus' history as a British Colony. The UK still holds on to the Sovereign Base Areas of Akrotiri and Dhekelia , which also have a bit of official coverage.
NOTE: To distinguish Cyprus from Greece, remember that Cyprus drives on the **left**.
